text: ROM shall contain constant-initialized immutable objects also accessible by read-only data views. Data/ROM mappings shall preserve identity/position/rights; data-to-ROM shall fault for RAM. Mappings between I/O and any other space shall be unsupported; the reference monitor shall have no data-space device aliases.
